scientific_integrity: Analytic inequalities and equality conditions proved for all finite character orders at least three and infinite order; exact rational code supplies supplementary finite consistency checks, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three consecutive powers of one character; not an arbitrary three-frequency set, higher-dimensional polynomial family, or general-exponent sharp Nikolskii bound. Literature completeness is not certified; an older equivalent low-degree calculation may exist.
title: Sharp three-character fourth-moment constants on compact Abelian groups
